Definition: from G696 and G2875; a beater (i.e. worker) of silver:--silversmith.
BiblicalUsage: The word is a silversmith, one who beats silver into shape, and it appears once, naming Demetrius, who makes silver shrines for Diana and brings no small gain to the craftsmen.
TheologicalSignificance: A silversmith's living depended on the idol, so the gospel sounded to him like bad business.
